metadata.scope: wall time includes process startup, file I/O, checksums, close and publication; excludes hashing/generation
metadata.cache: warm filesystem cache; no fsync, cache eviction, CPU pinning, or isolated host
metadata.memory: isolated GNU time child peak RSS on Linux; Windows peak working set via GetProcessMemoryInfo
metadata.measurement_overhead: Linux wall time includes GNU time launcher startup; CPU time includes helper and CLI
metadata.synthetic: text/skewed/repetitive repeat deterministic tiles; random uses full seeded bytes; compressed is gzip of seeded random
